crossRefs.note: Behold, Yahweh’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of…
His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of…
For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made its pyre deep and large with…
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me and behold, the Lord Yahweh called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep…
When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and…
For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
“At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him…

translations.web: For, behold, Yahweh will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
translations.bsb: For behold, the LORD will come with fire— His chariots are like a whirlwind— to execute His anger with fury and His rebuke with flames of fire.
translations.kjv: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
translations.asv: For, behold, Jehovah will come with fire, and his chariots shall be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
